message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover with a yellow background and red borders. At the top, the large red word "TEMPO" is centered. Below it, the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" appears in small, red, spaced-out letters.

The main subject is a caricature of a man with short dark hair, wearing a button-down, short-sleeved orange uniform and matching trousers. He stands with his arms slightly out, holding two orange traffic cones with white reflective bands on the ground beside his feet. His shadow is cast largely onto the yellow background behind him.

Large, bold black text to the left of the man reads: "MAMPUKAH IA MENOLAK REKLAMASI". A red slash mark is drawn through the "U" in "MAMPUKAH". Smaller black text below this title reads: "PENGEMBANG REKLAMASI MELOBI GUBERNUR JAKARTA YANG BARU LEWAT PEMERINTAH PUSAT DAN TOKOH PARTAI, TEKANAN DARI SEGALA PENJURU."

Smaller text at the top reads: "SIASAT DI BALIK DENSUS ANTIKORUPSI / PERANG GAMBUT SITI NURBAYA-SUKANTO TANOTO". A date and barcode are in the bottom left corner.
